items.bridge: The target owns two explicit preparation phases, exact private channel selection, selected-member enrichment, CRM relation grounding, complete private review, exact selected batches, and no-authority connected compilation without retaining the prompt guide as a fallback.

Collaboration Context owns portable workspace and channel meaning, workspace-scoped provider identity fingerprints, visibility, typed optional Person and Organization links, channel deduplication, and the exact provider-neutral ingestion policy; provider participants never become CRM people implicitly.

Slack Integration owns bounded public-and-private conversation identity reads and exact selected-channel human-participant reads; its separately declared message and thread reads remain private untrusted review inputs, and no Slack mutation capability exists.

The separate Communications provider mapping declares exact channel and policy read plus channel create, update, and schema translation, including create-only immutable workspace-scoped identity fields; Core still owns confirmation, one-time start, checkpoint, and verification authority.
The target proves exact selected-channel enrichment, bot exclusion, real CRM relation identities or explicit residue, create and update review, and zero preparation writes.
The target proves that member and organization relations contain exact existing resource identities or remain absent with visible handoffs; fabricated relation IDs cannot enter the proposal.
The target proves a complete public-and-private paginated identity review with zero member reads and zero proposed writes until a separate exact selected-channel preparation is supplied.
The final executable workflow responsibility in the mixed Ingestion card is target-owned by the typed Slack channel Automation.

The channel standardization, workspace-scoped identity, participant distinction, and typed cross-Context link meaning formerly summarized by the mixed card is target-owned by Collaboration Context rather than CRM.

The Slack provider read boundary formerly summarized by the mixed card is target-owned by Slack Integration through closed conversation, participant, message, and thread normalization with no mutation capability.
The channel provider-translation subset formerly summarized as publishing bindings is target-owned by the exact separate Notion Communications mapping with no CRM compatibility alias.

The catch-all promise that future source mechanisms should be forged under one mixed card is intentionally retired. New systems are independently declared Context, Automation, Integration, and configuration packs under Kernel verification rather than extending a central legacy Ingestion authority.
